title: Ordinary finite Kummer roots and ordered flag products
statement:
Fix a finite purity datum $P$ and its coefficient ring $A=A_{E,n}$, with $n\geq1$, as in [def-pur-conventions]. For any $k$-scheme $a:S\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and any invertible $\mathcal O_S$-module $M$ [def-sc-invertible-module], define its ordinary etale root $x_A(M):A_S\to L_{m,A,S}[2]$ to be the scalar-extended Kummer first Chern morphism of [lem-pur-kummer-additivity], with the fixed exponent $m=\ell^n$ and $L_{m,A,S}=\mu_m\otimes_{\mathbb Z/m}A_S$. For any scheme $S$ and any ordered family $x_0,\ldots,x_{r-1}$ of such degree-two etale morphisms (not necessarily arising from line bundles), define the coefficient classes $b_i(x_0,\ldots,x_{r-1})\in H^{2i}(S,A(i))$ and the ordered product $t(x_0,\ldots,x_{r-1})\in H^{2r}(S,A(r))$. Use the ordinary pro-etale groups, unit and full-support cup step of [def-pur-chern-classes]; each etale root is sent through the exact etale-to-pro-etale comparison before this cup step. Define
$$b_0(\varnothing)=1,\qquad b_{i+1}(\varnothing)=0,\qquad b_0(x_0,\ldots,x_{r-1})=1,$$
$$b_{i+1}(x_0,\ldots,x_r)=b_{i+1}(x_0,\ldots,x_{r-1})+b_i(x_0,\ldots,x_{r-1})\cup x_r,$$
and
$$t(\varnothing)=1,\qquad t(x_0,\ldots,x_r)=t(x_0,\ldots,x_{r-1})\cup x_r.$$
These are definitions by recursion, including the empty family, with the ordered shifted Tate identifications of the cited cup step. No Chern-class identity for a filtered bundle is asserted.

def ordinaryFiniteFlagRoot (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : S ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (M : S.Modules) (hM : M.IsInvertible) :
    Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit P.Coefficient S ⟶
      (Etale.ordinaryFiniteLine P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates S)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
